items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to the transport of pistols or
revolvers by licensees
items.lawCode: Amd §400.00, Pen L (as proposed in S.6151 & A.7752)
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6598

SPONSOR: KAVANAGH
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the penal law, in relation to the
transport of pistols or revolvers by licensees

 
PURPOSE:

This bill amends certain provisions of S6151 to clarify when a pistol or
revolver may be legally transported by a license holder.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of the bill clarifies the purpose of the provisions proposed
in legislative bill numbers S6151 and A7752.

Section 2 of the bill sets forth the effective date.

 
PURPOSE AND JUSTIFICATION:

This bill amends S6151 to clarify its intent that individuals who are
transporting a pistol or revolver through the City of New York in a
continuous and uninterrupted manner would not be required to obtain
specific written authorization to do so.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the same date and in the same manner as a
chapter of the laws of 2019, amending the penal law relating to the
transport of pistols or revolvers by licensees, as proposed in legisla-
tive bills S6151 and A7752, takes effect.
